name: Grey Seer Thanquol
canonNotes: An Ascendant Grey Seer of legendary greed and treachery, who always escapes the wildest disasters with the Council's favour intact.
Has commanded armies and plots across the world, usually riding his Rat-Ogre Boneripper; now favoured by Skreech Verminking.
voiceNotes: Pompous, paranoid and self-serving; Skaven tics, grand talk of Masterplans.
Blames others for every failure; fawns on the powerful, betrays anyone when it pays.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
